title: Shop calendar
summary: Daily calendar of opening days, closures and local events for the Valdena gelato shop in northern Italy. Contains one row per day from 2022-01-01 onward with a boolean flag for whether the shop was open and an optional text field naming local events. The source is updated weekly and is open to analytics roles. It covers the full history and recent windows needed (through 2026-03-31).
